build.name: compile ODEPACK (3 files) + Techne's Robertson driver
build.cmd: gfortran -O1 -std=legacy -w -o $BODY/build/rob $HARNESS/robertson.f opkdmain.f opkda1.f opkda2.f 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -x $BODY/build/rob && echo built

runs.name: MF=21 (BDF, stiff, analytic Jacobian): Robertson to t=4e10
PATHOLOGY MF=10 (Adams, non-stiff) on the same stiff problem: step budget exhausted (ISTATE=-1)

notes: The failing run is the specimen's documented behaviour, not a bug: a non-stiff method on a stiff problem exhausts MXSTEP (ISTATE=-1). The corrected descendant is the same code with MF=21. Oracle for MF=21: reaching T=4e10 with y1 ~ 0 (Hindmarsh's demo values).
